# Command line reference

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen_docs.py from the typer command tree. Do not edit by hand. -->

`studioforge` runs the server and manages it. Commands that act on a running server (`ls`, `ps`, `load`, `unload`, `get`, `update`, `log stream`, `server stop`) talk to it on this machine over its HTTP API and need no setup: a local admin key is used automatically. `sfctl` (a separate package) is the same idea for a server on another machine.

Every command accepts `--help`. Commands that read configuration take `--config PATH` (default: the data directory's `config.yaml`; `SF_DATA_DIR` chooses the data directory).

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`studioforge autostart`](#studioforge-autostart) | Start StudioForge automatically when you log in. |
| [`studioforge capabilities`](#studioforge-capabilities) | Show the backend, what it can run, and what your hardware allows. |
| [`studioforge config`](#studioforge-config) | Print the effective configuration (secrets redacted), or check config.yaml. |
| [`studioforge config check`](#studioforge-config-check) | Validate config.yaml the way `serve` will load it; name every key that is wrong. |
| [`studioforge doctor`](#studioforge-doctor) | Check ports, GPU, engine, disk, permissions, certificate, migrations and auth. |
| [`studioforge engine`](#studioforge-engine) | Inspect, install, activate or update llama.cpp engine builds. |
| [`studioforge engine benchmark`](#studioforge-engine-benchmark) | Measure pp512 / tg128 for the ACTIVE engine on this box and cache the result. |
| [`studioforge engine install`](#studioforge-engine-install) | Install one llama.cpp build for the detected GPU backend (does not switch to it). |
| [`studioforge engine list`](#studioforge-engine-list) | List installed engines: backend, checksum verification, smoke test, install date. |

## studioforge autostart

Start StudioForge automatically when you log in.

```
studioforge autostart
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | str | `status` | status \| enable \| disable |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  |
| `--open` | flag |  | Also open the control panel when it starts at login |
| `--tray` | flag |  | Start the system tray at login, which brings the server up with it (Windows) |

## studioforge engine

Inspect, install, activate or update llama.cpp engine builds.

```
studioforge engine COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  |
| `--install` | str |  | Install a specific llama.cpp tag |
| `--activate` | str |  | Make an installed build the live engine and pin it |
| `--activate-after-install` | flag |  | With --install: activate and pin the build once it is installed |
| `--smoke-test` | flag |  | Smoke-test the active engine |
| `--check` | flag |  | Report the newest release, install nothing |
| `--update` | flag |  | Install the newest llama.cpp release and make it the default |
| `--list` | flag |  | List the installable llama.cpp release tags and exit |

## studioforge engine benchmark

Measure pp512 / tg128 for the ACTIVE engine on this box and cache the result.

SPAWNS llama-bench ON THE GPU for up to several minutes, so it needs --yes. Stop the models you care about first. STRICT_GPU applies (-ngl 999). Nothing else in StudioForge ever runs this.

```
studioforge engine benchmark
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--model` | path |  | A GGUF that fits the GPU entirely |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  |
| `--device` | str |  | llama.cpp device name (see `llama-server --list-devices`) |
| `--model-class` | str |  | Label stored with the result |
| `--yes` | flag |  | Confirm: this loads the model onto the GPU and runs llama-bench |

## studioforge engine list

List installed engines: backend, checksum verification, smoke test, install date.

Read-only: nothing is downloaded, installed or started. VERIFIED is `yes` (archive matched a published SHA-256), `NO` (installed without one -- see the warning under the row), `source` (compiled locally) or `unknown` (installed before checksums were recorded).

```
studioforge engine list
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print the records as JSON |

## studioforge engine select

Show which backend the cached benchmark results recommend per GPU.

Read-only. Results come from `engine benchmark`; with none cached this says so and recommends nothing.

```
studioforge engine select
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  |
| `--preference` | str |  | balanced \| fastest_replies \| fastest_long_prompts (default: engine.preference) |

## studioforge keys

API keys: named, scoped, revocable.

```
studioforge keys COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## studioforge keys create

Create an API key. The token is printed once and cannot be shown again.

Creating the first key turns authentication on: every client (on this machine too) then needs a key. The CLI, the tray and the panel on this machine get their own automatically.

```
studioforge keys create
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--name`, `-n` | str |  | A label, e.g. openclaw or my-agent. |
| `--scope`, `-s` | str | `inference` | read (look only) \| inference (chat, load) \| admin. |
| `--expires-in-days` | float range |  |  |
| `--rate-limit-rpm` | int range |  |  |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print machine-readable JSON. |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  | Path to config.yaml |

## studioforge keys list

List keys (never the tokens).

```
studioforge keys list
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | flag |  | Include revoked keys. |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print machine-readable JSON. |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  | Path to config.yaml |

## studioforge load

Load a model. Without options the server picks the context and the cards.

```
studioforge load
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | str |  | Model id (see `studioforge ls`). |
| `--ttl` | int range |  | Idle seconds before it unloads. |
| `--context-length`, `--ctx` | int range |  | Context window per conversation. |
| `--gpu` | str |  | GPU indices to use, e.g. 0 or 0,1. |
| `--preset` | str |  | Placement mode for the recommended load (see `GET /api/catalog`). |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print machine-readable JSON. |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  | Path to config.yaml |

## studioforge open

Handle a deep link from HuggingFace's "Use this model" button.

HuggingFace emits ``lmstudio://open_from_hf?model=<owner>/<repo>``; this resolves it to the StudioForge GUI's Download tab with that repo's quant picker open.

```
studioforge open
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | str |  | A studioforge:// or lmstudio:// deep link |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  |
| `--print` | flag |  | Print the URL, do not open |

## studioforge protocol

Register StudioForge as a URL-scheme handler for model deep links.

```
studioforge protocol
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | str | `status` | status \| register \| unregister |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  |
| `--takeover-lmstudio` | flag |  | Also claim lmstudio:// so HuggingFace's LM Studio button opens StudioForge. Reversible: the previous handler is backed up and restored by 'protocol unregister'. |

## studioforge setup

Guided first run: account, hardware, engine, library, starter model, test chat, exposure.

```
studioforge setup
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--non-interactive`, `-y` | flag |  | Never ask; use the flags (for scripts and CI). |
| `--username` | str |  | Owner account username. |
| `--password-env` | str |  | Env var holding the owner password. |
| `--password-stdin` | flag |  | Read the password on stdin. |
| `--skip-account` | flag |  | Local-only: no account. |
| `--library` | str |  | 'lmstudio', 'auto', or a folder to use as the model library. |
| `--engine-tag` | str |  | llama.cpp build to install. |
| `--skip-engine` | flag |  |  |
| `--model` | str |  | Hugging Face repo to download, or a model id already in the library. |
| `--skip-model` | flag |  |  |
| `--skip-chat` | flag |  |  |
| `--exposure` | str |  | local \| lan (HTTPS on the network) \| peer (later). Default: keep a network binding that is already configured, else local. |
| `--no-start` | flag |  | Do not start the server for steps 5-6. |
| `--json` | flag |  | Print machine-readable JSON. |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  | Path to config.yaml |

## studioforge users

Owner accounts for the control panel.

```
studioforge users COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## studioforge users add

Create an account for the control panel (and satisfy the network-bind rule).

``add`` is the same command. The password is read from ``--password-env`` or ``--password-stdin`` (or prompted for), never taken as an argument.

```
studioforge users add
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | str |  | Username (the first account is the owner). |
| `--password-env` | str |  | Read it from this env var. |
| `--password-stdin` | flag |  | Read it from stdin. |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  | Path to config.yaml |

## studioforge users create

Create an account for the control panel (and satisfy the network-bind rule).

``add`` is the same command. The password is read from ``--password-env`` or ``--password-stdin`` (or prompted for), never taken as an argument.

```
studioforge users create
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | str |  | Username (the first account is the owner). |
| `--password-env` | str |  | Read it from this env var. |
| `--password-stdin` | flag |  | Read it from stdin. |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  | Path to config.yaml |

## studioforge users delete

Delete an account and its password. Its panel sessions end; API keys are kept.

Refuses the last account that can sign in (with no admin key to fall back on) unless ``--force``: a network-bound server would refuse to start.

```
studioforge users delete
```

| Option | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | str |  | The account to remove. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  | Do not ask for confirmation. |
| `--force` | flag |  | Allow deleting the last account that can sign in. |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  | Path to config.yaml |
